quality_rule: On these fixtures only, a clear descriptive accuracy advantage requires at least +0.15 paired median micro-F1, at least 2 fewer FN over the 14 positives in at least 2 of 3 pairs, no median increase in the number of FP and median generated-document score at least the baseline. All arms have to complete all 8 documents in every counted pair.
efficiency_rule: A descriptive efficiency advantage requires all 3 matched pairs to complete, a median of at most one additional wrong binary cell per 56, no lower median generation score, and at least 30% lower median successful wall time or 30% fewer median tool calls counted identically in both arms. Identify efficiency separately from accuracy.
limits: Two clean controls, six defect-positive files, 14 positive and 42 negative labels. Small fixed synthetic corpus. No population-level, all-schools, model-independent or novelty-priority inference.
